messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH: 3xx errors for /v1/embeddings in prod-us-west (rate=4.8% over 5m) — paging alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: oncall here, acked. any initial customer reports? sam_support: we have a ticket from acme-corp reporting embeddings returning short garbage vectors + 500s starting ~09:01 UTC.

bob_sre: looking at router logs — see a spike in fallback routes for route=embed-prod -> pinned_variant=redwood-chat-v2 (incompatible). many requests are being routed to a chat-variant runtime that expects chat schema. stacktrace shows schema validation failures then 500s.

eva_engineer: who owns pins/anchors? I thought embed-prod alias points to embed-quant-v3.

carla_prod: I pushed an alias change earlier this morning for a canary and added a new pin for chat experiments, but that was scoped to /gen routes only. looks like the new smart-routing policy match condition might have been too broad.

alice_oncall: can we confirm failing example request payloads?

bob_sre: pasted a sample from router logs: ```POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "embed-prod", "input": "customer doc..." }``` then routed to variant `redwood-chat-v2`. downstream runtime error: `Expected embed schema, got chat request -> handler: chat_generate() -> KeyError: 'inputs'`

sam_support: acme-corp provided an example; it matches what bob found.

alice_oncall: impact: 3 customers with heavy embedding traffic (acme-corp, beta-data, searchly). error rate peaked at 9% at 09:04, now ~4.8%. token throughput unaffected. This is causing user-facing failures for search indexing jobs.

eva_engineer: root cause hypothesis: the smart-fallback policy 'smart-fallback-v2' was updated to match by alias prefix `embed-` but a recent pin operation used alias `embed-prod-chat-canary` and inadvertently pinned chat variant to the global embed alias space. Router prefers pinned variants over compatibility mapping so requests got pinned to chat variant.

carla_prod: yep that matches my change. I created pin via console: `POST /admin/pins { alias: "embed-prod-chat-canary", variant: "redwood-chat-v2" }` I thought alias namespaced under 'gen' team but apparently alias uniqueness is global. my bad.

bob_sre: mitigation options: 1) remove the offending pin 2) add temporary routing override to prefer compatible variants (compat-fallback) 3) rollback recent policy change. fastest is to unpin.

alice_oncall: do it. carla, can you unpin now?

carla_prod: unpinning now: ```curl -X DELETE "https://controlplane.internal/api/pins/embed-prod-chat-canary" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"```

incident-bot: Action logged: pin-delete by carla_prod at 09:12:07 UTC.

bob_sre: router config shows pin removed. I'm seeing embed requests re-evaluated; new routes go to embed-quant-v3. error rate dropping. current error rate 1.1% (09:15).

sam_support: acme-corp confirms partial recovery for their job queue.

eva_engineer: rolling check for other accidental pins: running query: ```SELECT * FROM pins WHERE alias LIKE 'embed-%' AND variant LIKE '%chat%'``` — found 1 other test pin in staging only. prod now clean.

alice_oncall: good. next steps: we need to prevent global alias collisions and make pin API require namespace or owner. carla, please open a ticket and include the exact console call and alias naming guidance.

carla_prod: created ticket: #INC-4521 with details and root-cause notes. assigning to infra for validation and console UX.

bob_sre: temporary mitigation verified. I'm keeping an eye for a full 30m window. also enabling extra logging for smart-fallback decisions.

sam_support: customer impact summary for oncall handoff: affected customers: acme-corp, beta-data, searchly. total embedding requests affected ~42k over incident window. customer-facing errors ~3.6k. SLA risk: minor (partial degradation). Tickets updated.

alice_oncall: handing off to eve (tomorrow oncall) — I'll include timeline and mitigation steps in #INC-4521. Anyone else?

eva_engineer: quick follow-ups for postmortem: - require alias name validation (namespace prefix) - pin API to include owner and warn on global collisions - add pre-flight simulation when pinning to detect incompatible model types - update smart-fallback policy tests to cover alias edge cases

carla_prod: agree. will draft postmortem and timeline.

bob_sre: logging: saved router traces -> /var/log/router/traces/1713456789-embed-pin-mismatch.log. saved a snapshot of config diff at 09:10.

incident-bot: Incident resolved? false -> monitoring.

alice_oncall: error rate stable at 0.2% now, will mark as resolved after 30m no-regression. leaving thread open for postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:

carla_prod: postmortem draft link: https://redwood.internal/pm/incidents/INC-4521 (DRAFT)

eva_engineer: pinging infra to add guard rails. tagging @infra-team.

sam_support: I'll send customer outreach draft to customers affected.

alice_oncall: thanks everyone — closing pager. last update 09:22 UTC.

(automated note: thread ends; follow-ups tracked in INC-4521)
